output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    th=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==3]
    if not th or not pts: return out
    # clear all 3s
    for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=0
    rows={r for r,c in th}; cols={c for r,c in th}
    if len(cols)==1: # vertical separator
        tc=next(iter(cols)); minc=min(c for r,c in pts); maxc=max(c for r,c in pts)
        if tc < minc:
            axis=maxc; new=[(r,2*axis-c) for r,c in pts]
        else:
            axis=minc; new=[(r,2*axis-c) for r,c in pts]
        for r in range(h): out[r][axis]=8
    else: # horizontal separator
        tr=next(iter(rows)); minr=min(r for r,c in pts); maxr=max(r for r,c in pts)
        if tr < minr: axis=maxr
        else: axis=minr
        new=[(2*axis-r,c) for r,c in pts]
        for c in range(w): out[axis][c]=8
    for r,c in new:
        if 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w and out[r][c]!=2 and not (r==axis if len(cols)!=1 else c==axis): out[r][c]=3
    return out"}
